titleText: JTF News: BBC News, CBC News
mainText: A former Virginia deputy governor died by suicide after killing his wife, according to police.
Russia conducted an aerial attack in Ukraine that resulted in 18 deaths.
Civilians are caught in crossfire during the Sudan civil war between the army and RSF.
Nine people killed in a shooting at a school in Turkey; this is the second such incident in two days.
